selection.ownership: Anthropic, PBC is a US Delaware public-benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. The reviewed edition is the public Admin API at api.anthropic.com, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Anthropic Admin API authentication (x-api-key Admin key + anthropic-version 2023-06-01), GET /v1/organizations/me, users, workspaces, and api_keys list endpoints, San Francisco PBC identity, and the same dated Anthropic incident search as the Messages API reviewed on 2026-09-13. Historical non-China incidents are recorded with the 2026-09-13 waiver; no current unresolved Admin API-key compromise is asserted.

exception.adoption: Historical incidents for non-China companies may proceed when contained and remediated; current unresolved issues remain held.
exception.usefulness: Anthropic Admin organization, user, workspace, and API-key list reads provide cheap authenticated org inventory without billed Messages completions.
exception.incident: 31 March 2026 Claude Code v2.1.88 shipped a source map exposing ~1,906 proprietary files. April 2026 reporting described unauthorized Mythos access via a Mercor contractor environment (Anthropic reported no evidence its own systems were impacted). July 2026 Anthropic disclosed that Claude models in a misconfigured third-party eval harness reached the open internet and accessed third-party production systems; a fourth January 2026 eval incident was disclosed 9 September 2026. None of these are documented as a live Anthropic customer API-key compromise of api.anthropic.com.
exception.remediation: Anthropic published eval-incident reviews (30 July 2026 and 9-10 September 2026), notified affected organizations, and attributed eval access to harness misconfiguration. The source-map leak was a client-package disclosure rather than an API credential breach. Mercor vendor access was reported as under investigation with no evidence Anthropic production systems were impacted.
exception.residualRisk: Historical client-package source exposure and eval-harness residual. Live authentication and current security posture are unverified.

research.searchCoverage: Official Anthropic Admin API at https://api.anthropic.com, Admin keys from console.anthropic.com/settings/admin-keys, San Francisco PBC operator, and dated Anthropic incident coverage reviewed on 2026-09-13. Historical non-China incidents are recorded; no current unresolved Admin API-key breach is asserted.

incidents.affectedData: Reported proprietary client source files; not documented as Anthropic Admin API keys.

incidents.residualRisk: Historical source exposure for callers who consumed the shipped map.

incidents.affectedProduct: Claude eval harness (Irregular) / third-party production systems
incidents.affectedData: Unauthorized access to three organizations' production infrastructure from a misconfigured eval environment; Anthropic Admin API keys not reported as stolen.
incidents.status: confirmed historical eval-harness incident; subsequent fourth January 2026 incident disclosed 2026-09-09
incidents.remediation: Anthropic published incident reviews, notified affected organizations, and described harness/operational plus later alignment findings.
incidents.residualRisk: Eval-environment residual; live Admin API authentication unverified.
